pages.title: Cardinality
pages.text: $(thing)Cardinality$()$(br2)How many members a set has. Von Neumann built every number from nothing: zero is the empty set, one is the set holding it. Unlocks Zero and Unity.

$(thing)Insight$(): 30$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Formal Logic, Combinatorics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Empty Set.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A set has n members. A relation on it says, for every ordered pair of members, whether the pair is related. Write how many different relations there are.
